singleSliderTrackIconSample.mechanism: Slider custom track lambda plus Modifier.drawWithContent and DrawScope painters
singleSliderTrackIconSample.accessibility: Icons are painted inside DrawScope and the sample creates no separate semantic node or content description for them.

rangeSlider.differenceFromSingleSlider: No dedicated icon contract exists for either component; only the generic custom-track composition capability is shared structurally.

canonical.composeCoverage: No size-specific SliderTokens.kt files in the pinned 120-file denominator

web.interactionOwner: React Aria Components Slider, SliderTrack and SliderThumb
web.reason: The reviewed Compose source exposes generic custom thumb/track composition, and the only track-icon example implements icons manually inside that generic track hook. Adding a Kotlin-shaped trackIcon or custom-track renderer to m3-ui solely for this sample would duplicate or bypass the locked React Aria slider semantics boundary without a dedicated Material public contract.
web.accessibility: The reviewed Compose sample treats the icons as decorative paint. No independent accessible name, role or state is established. A future semantic icon contract would require a separate accessibility review rather than inheriting semantics from this sample.
web.rtl: No dedicated upstream track-icon RTL contract or token exists at the reviewed pin. React Aria continues to own slider direction and value semantics; Compose DrawScope offset arithmetic is not ported as a web API.
web.disabled: The reviewed track-icon sample does not establish a disabled icon contract, and the canonical graph has no icon-specific disabled token. Existing slider disabled semantics and paint remain unchanged.
